_extraction_flags.notes: Valid Simulation/Optimization Paper. Focuses on Resource Allocation (Slot Selection + Power) for TDMA-based Indoor Visible Light Communication and Sensing (IVLCS).

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig 1: Indoor IVLCS system model. Fig 9: Total Power vs Slots. Comparison of proposed SPPM-JSSPA vs benchmarks. Fig 8: Power vs CSR threshold.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Indoor IVLCS (Visible Light). Access: TDMA. Optimization: Minimize Total Power under constraints (ENR for Sensing, CSR for Comm). Methods: Joint Slot Selection and Power Allocation.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: CSR (Communication Sum Rate) > 1 bit/s/Hz. Sensing: ENR (Echo-to-Noise Ratio) > 0 dB. Power: Minimized (e.g., ~2-4 W).
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Addresses the resource competition in TDMA-based ISAC. 'Sensing Priority' approach (allocating sensing slots first) is adopted.

bibliographic.title: Joint Optimization of Slot Selection and Power Allocation in Integrated Visible Light Communication and Sensing Systems
bibliographic.authors: Jin-Yuan Wang, Hao-Nan Yang, Jun-Bo Wang, Min Lin, Peicheng Shi

application.scenario_description: Indoor IVLCS system with 1 Transceiver (LED+PD) and M Users on floor. Simultaneous Comm (Downlink) and Sensing (Active, detecting users).

key_contribution.key_contribution: Joint optimization of Time Slot Selection and Power Allocation (SPPM-JSSPA algorithm) to minimize total power while satisfying Sensing ENR and Comm CSR constraints.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Resource allocation (slots/power) in TDMA-based Integrated Visible Light Communication and Sensing (IVLCS) systems.

transmitter.notes: LED Transceiver. OOK Modulation. TDMA frame structure.

receiver.notes: Users have PDs (Comm Rx). Transceiver has PD (Sensing Rx).

integration.notes: TDMA. Time slots allocated either to Sensing or Communication.

waveform.notes: Time slots are dynamically assigned. Pulse based.

channel_wireless.notes: Indoor room 10x10x3m. Distance approx 3m (Ceiling to floor).

tradeoff.notes: Trade-off between Total Power consumption and Sensing/Comm Requirements.
